items.title: U.S. banking agency gives blockchain bank OpenReserve initial OK to operate
items.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted a provisional charter to the new full-service bank, adding it to the growing mix of crypto-native institutions.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: AMC CEO blasts Robinhood for stock token, putting synthetic shares in spotlight
items.snippet: Adam Aron said AMC has no connection to Robinhood’s tokenized shares, reviving questions around how stocks are brought onchain.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
